features.content:
Feature 1: Cost Optimization
Capability: Helps organizations save on software licenses by analyzing usage and identifying inactive users.
Value: Average savings of 22% to 30% on licenses by identifying underutilized applications.
Limitations: Savings depend on accurate identification of inactive users and may vary based on the organization's specific usage patterns.
Status: Available

Feature 2: License Management
Capability: Tracks the number of users and their activity levels across applications to optimize license usage.
Value: Provides insights into active vs. inactive users, enabling better license allocation and cost savings.
Limitations: Requires accurate user activity tracking; inactive users are defined as those who haven't logged in for 30 days, which may not suit all organizations.
Status: Available

Feature 3: Shadow IT Detection
Capability: Identifies applications being used that are not compliant with organizational policies.
Value: Helps organizations gain visibility into unauthorized applications, reducing security risks.
Limitations: Detection of shadow IT can be challenging and may not capture all instances of non-compliance.
Status: Available

Feature 4: SaaS Application Integration
Capability: Integrates with major SaaS applications through APIs for easy management.
Value: Simplifies the process of adding and managing applications, especially with SSO integration.
Limitations: Not all applications provide API endpoints; manual addition may be required for some applications.
Status: Available

Feature 5: Spend Analytics
Capability: Analyzes spending on SaaS subscriptions and provides detailed reports on usage.
Value: Enables organizations to understand their spending patterns and identify potential savings.
Limitations: Requires accurate data input and may not account for all factors affecting spending.
Status: Available

Feature 6: Overlapping Applications Analysis
Capability: Identifies applications with similar functionalities to reduce redundancy.
Value: Helps organizations consolidate tools and cut costs by eliminating unnecessary applications.
Limitations: Requires manual review to determine which applications can be consolidated based on specific needs.
Status: Available
